answer_1.quote: we propose a method to extract the logical propositions, relations and implications to guide LLMs to generate proof sketches for automated theorem proving and explanation refinement.
answer_1.outputs: refined natural language explanations and proof sketches

answer_2.quote: We adopt a range of automatic metrics to measure the quality of explanations and autoformalisation, showing that the proposed framework significantly improve the faithfulness of the autoformalisation process.

answer_4.quote: We further conducted a human evaluation on three types of errors: variable errors (identifiable by the theorem prover), implication errors, and quantifier errors (not identifiable by the theorem prover)
answer_4.guideline: assess the perceived quality of the formalised logical forms by evaluating variable, implication, and quantifier errors
